definitions.explanation: A construction technology that reduces a building's shaking during an earthquake by installing dampers that absorb seismic energy. Distinguished from {耐震|たいしん} (making the structure strong enough to resist quakes) and {免震|めんしん} (isolating the building from ground motion).

examples.japanese: {制震|せいしん}⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧。
examples.english: a building with a damping structure

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{制震|せいしん}⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{備|そな}えている→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: This building is equipped with damping devices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れ→揺れ：16137_yure⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{制震|せいしん}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: to reduce earthquake shaking with damping technology

notes:
Construction-industry term; one of three main earthquake-countermeasure approaches.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {制震|せいしん}⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧: damping structure
- {制震|せいしん}⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧: damping device, damper
- {制震|せいしん}ダンパー: seismic damper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{耐震|たいしん}→耐震：06222_taishin⟧: earthquake resistance — making the structure itself strong enough to withstand shaking
- ⟦{免震|めんしん}→免震：20985_menshin⟧: base isolation — separating the building from ground motion with isolators
